verdict.rationale: The CLI documents several bulk operations. You can install every skill in a repo with `'*'` or name several with repeated `--skill` flags, and target many agents at once with `-a claude-code -a opencode`. `npx skills update` with no arguments updates all installed skills, or you can pass several names. Removal works across multiple agents, all skills can be restored from skills-lock.json, and `-y` makes runs non-interactive for CI. Older community comments say update and uninstall were undocumented, but they cite no hands-on failure and the current README documents both, so this is not a dispute. Missing for 10: no evidenced remove-all or wildcard removal, no dry-run or preview for bulk changes, and no independent hands-on corroboration of bulk runs at scale.
